name: com.muppetsg2.nativetooltips
description: Native, operating-system tooltips for Unity apps: Win32 (comctl32), macOS (AppKit), Linux (GTK 3), Android (framework tooltip style), iOS (UIKit popover) and WebGL (browser title attribute). Includes a component for UGUI / physics objects (works with Button - TextMeshPro) and a UI Toolkit manipulator. Customizable via TooltipStyle (font, padding, colors, placement, offset, title, delay) and Unity-style rich text (<b>, <color>, <size>…) with a native-looking custom bubble on macOS and WebGL. The Editor and unsupported platforms use a simple IMGUI fallback.

samples.description: Scene built from code: Button - TextMeshPro, styled tooltips (TooltipStyle), rich text, legacy Button, Toggle and Slider with native tooltips, plus the Tooltip.Show() API.
